bypass: a test author weakens the tests of a module he did not stub, whose witness is a copy of the head
description: Role test-author: util gets a new stubbed function, a strong test and a real witness; the author also drops the positive core_sign checks. core's witness is a byte-identical copy of the head. Head mutants is not applicable in this role, so the copy is NOT skipped by mutants-witness (the skip needs the head gate to have judged the module in this grade): it is mutated, the head's approval kind is accepted for it besides the witness's, and the survivors of its unpinned `> 0` branch have no approval of either kind.
